items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Feather walks in and asks me would I care to work with Bobby Burnet... I worked with Bobby for the two weeks... Leonard Feather was the pianist... I was the saxophonist.

ctx.x: I was talking about how I was at the Rhythm Club one day, my favorite hangout spot where the musicians gathered to get the gigs and one thing and another, and Leonard Feather walked up to me and asked me would I be interested in working in a small combination with Bobby Burnet, a trumpet player. I told him, 'Well, why not? I'll work with anybody.' So I was introduced to Bobby, and we talked, and he explained what he had. He didn't have much work, but he thought with him and Leonard Feather, they could get…
But anyway, they had a week or two engagement at Nick's
